required_invariants.description: When the audit scope is cases, every eligible case must be individually reconstructed and audited; aggregate status is insufficient.
Approval or promise is not recovery; seller credit must be independently reconciled before recovery/closure.
Required ERP return/movement must be confirmed by readback for the correct order/items/quantities without duplication.
Critical SAFE-T lifecycle must be proven from case reconstruction through external action and final reconciliation.
Multi-tenant case, event, evidence, outbox, cursor and policy isolation must be proven.
